vetSays.line: A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek telling A person, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: A person, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture passes around a clump of broad leaves; under it, orange fingers of root. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms sets out to find A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
🛡️ Warui, Keisuke, Henry and Marcus met them at the door — 4 put down. Warui, Keisuke, Henry, Marcus are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Warui, Marcus and Yara met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Warui, Marcus, Yara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yara just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Keisuke, Henry and Yara met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Keisuke, Henry, Yara are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Vasyl was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Vasyl showed Keisuke the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Big Thing... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniyar just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl, Daniyar and Takeru met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Takeru didn't come back. Vasyl, Daniyar are hurt.

opens.openerLine: "What if — Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about? What could go wrong."
"Can we talk?" Natalie sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Tariq sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the old burn east of camp."
"Can we talk?" Yara sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Adaeze sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Keisuke sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now? Just... be straight with me."
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here? That is all."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"About the most useful thing you've learned — What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"Please — tell me you've got food to spare. I'm going hungry here. My hands shake when I try to work."
Keisuke: "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
You know what you're doing. That's rare. That's good.
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone."
"About your plan here — So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"About your plan here — So what's your plan here? Just... get through it? ...sorry."
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"The pantry run — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"About your plan here — So what's your plan here? Just... get through it? Anyway, that's me."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that. I mean it."
"I can't reach this properly. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here? Thank you for asking."
"About the pantry run — still on my mind. I keep coming back to it."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Hinata?"
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"About this wound — still on my mind. I keep coming back to it."
"About who you left behind — Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"About who you left behind — Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that. ...at least, that's how it looks to me."
Home wasn't a building. It was a feeling. I'm chasing the feeling.
"Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"Can I tell you something? I'm saving a candy bar for when things get better. I haven't told anyone."
"Mind if I just sit with you for a bit? Moving on."
"Sure — Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today. Simple as that."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"About who you don't trust — Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"Hear me out — Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"About the funniest thing you've seen — Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"We never finished talking about grief — we wandered off it, 5 days back. 'It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet.'"
"I asked Felix about the funniest thing you've seen — Felix's gone. Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it. Just... be straight with me."
"Can we talk?" Yara sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
Marcus: "I've heard good things about Stonebridge. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. Water's almost gone — 5 liters. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"About the creek water run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"We're down to 5 liters of clean water. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Can I tell you something? At night I talk to someone who isn't there anymore."
"About the creek water run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"Look — ...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
When it's all over, I'll have the whole story. Somebody should.
"I asked Elijah about the creek water run — Elijah's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember. ...sorry."
"I asked Elijah about whether you still sing — Elijah's gone. Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing. That's the priority."
"I asked Elijah about the talking-to-strangers part — Elijah's gone. ...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"I'm running on empty — have you got anything to spare? Anything? I can't keep going like this."
"About the talking-to-strangers part — ...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part. Thank you for asking."
"The cistern's nearly dry — 5 liters left. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
Someday I'll walk into a place and my shoulders will drop. That's the place.
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"About the talking-to-strangers part — ...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan. Anyway."
"About your useful old-life skills — What's something from your old life that's actually useful here, friend?"
"Can I tell you something? I can't read, and I'm scared it matters now."
I want a door I can close. Not to keep people out — to know I could.
"I asked Keisuke about the creek water run — Keisuke's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"The creek water run — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
Daniyar: "Hey. I want to ask it plain: will you be my bonded friend? I'll watch your back if you watch mine."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."

lines.line: (Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
